resources.string: Meeting Recorder saves every meeting as a folder with its audio, photos and notes. Choose or create a folder, for example Documents/Meetings.
Meetings are stored unencrypted in this folder. If a sync or cloud service is set up for the folder, it will copy your meetings off this phone.
This folder cannot be used: %1$s Please choose another folder.
The storage folder is no longer available. Please choose it again.
Recording a conversation is only allowed with the consent of all participants. Make sure that everyone present agrees to being recorded before you start.
I will make sure everyone agrees
Microphone: needed to record the audio of the meeting.
Notifications: show that a recording is running and let you stop it from the notification.
Without microphone access no recording is possible.
The microphone cannot be used. Check the permission and that no other app is using it.
The recording could not be started: %1$s
Nothing was recorded, so no meeting was saved.
The recording hit a problem (%1$s). What was recorded so far is kept.
Part of the audio could not be saved in time and is missing from the recording.
No meetings yet. Start a recording to create one.
No meeting data leaves this device. The only network use is downloading a speech recognition model when you tap Download.
Storage is almost full (%1$s left). Free up space soon.
Storage is full. The recording was stopped and saved up to this point.

plurals.name: limit_approaching
plurals.item: The maximum recording length is reached in %1$d minute. The recording will then stop and be saved.
The maximum recording length is reached in %1$d minutes. The recording will then stop and be saved.

resources.string: The maximum recording length was reached. The recording was stopped and saved.
There is not enough free storage to start a recording.
The microphone was taken by another app or a call. Your recording is paused; tap Resume to continue.
Reading from the microphone failed. Your recording is paused; tap Resume to continue.
Camera: needed to take photos of a whiteboard or slides during the meeting. Each photo is placed at the current point of the recording. Recording works without it.
Without camera access no photos can be taken. Recording is not affected.
The photo could not be saved. The recording continues.
This meeting was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
The audio of this meeting cannot be played.
Enter a title of 1 to 200 characters.
The meeting could not be renamed.
“%1$s” with its audio and photos will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
The meeting could not be deleted.
The microphone “%1$s” was disconnected. Recording continues with “%2$s”.
“%1$s” is available. It will be used from the next recording.
The microphone was disconnected and the built-in microphone could not be opened. Your recording is paused; tap Resume to continue.
Internet: only to download a speech recognition model after you tap Download. Meeting data is never sent.
Keep awake: keeps the processor running while a transcription or a download runs with the screen off.
Background work: lets a transcription or a download continue when you leave the app.
Transcription runs on this device with a model you install here. Nothing is downloaded until you tap Download.
No speech recognition models are available in this version. You can still import a model from a file.
The app needs internet access only to download a model. No meeting data is ever sent.
The fastest model, about 6 times faster than the recording on the test phone. Roughly one word in four is wrong on clear German speech. Good for a quick draft or an old phone.
About 3 times faster than the recording on the test phone, roughly one word in seven wrong on clear German speech. Small download.
About 5 times faster than the recording on the test phone, roughly one word in five wrong on clear German speech. Faster but less accurate than the compact Base.

Best accuracy that still runs in time: about 2 times faster than the recording on the test phone, roughly one word in ten wrong on clear German speech. Meetings with several speakers and noise are harder.
“%1$s” (%2$s) is downloaded from the internet, from %3$s. No meeting data is sent. License: %4$s.
The file is damaged (checksum mismatch) and was not installed.
The connection was lost. You can resume the download.
Unexpected download address. The download was stopped.
The file on the server changed. It was not installed.
Not enough free space: %1$s more is needed.
This file is not a speech recognition model.
The file could not be imported.
This model is used by a running transcription. Try again when it has finished.
“%1$s” will be deleted from this device. Transcripts stay as they are.
This model is not suited to this language.
This model needs a lot of memory on this phone. The transcription may fail.
No speech recognition model is installed. Install one first.
This meeting is still being recorded.
This transcription cannot be resumed. Start it over.
The transcription was interrupted. You can resume it.
The transcription was stopped because a recording started. You can resume it later.
The speech recognition model is not installed any more.
The speech recognition model could not be loaded. Install it again.
The phone ran out of memory. Try a smaller model.
The transcript could not be saved. Free some storage and try again.
The audio of this meeting could not be read.
The transcription failed because of an unexpected error.
Notifications are off. The transcription still runs; open the app to see its progress.
A transcription of this meeting is running. It will be cancelled.
The running transcription could not be stopped in time. Try again.
No transcript yet. Transcribe this meeting to read what was said and jump into the audio.
The transcript could not be read. You can transcribe the meeting again.
At %1$s: %2$s. Double tap to play from here
Photo %1$d at %2$s. Double tap to open
The new transcription did not finish. The earlier transcript below is unchanged.
The model used is no longer installed. Start over with another model.
The existing transcript is replaced when the new one is complete. Until then it stays readable and unchanged.
Confirm that the existing transcript may be replaced.
